name: p6g8-formrow-overlap
description: spawn form: working-directory FormRow must shrink inside its flex row instead of overflowing (kata p6g8)

mutation.note: Re-verified after the case picked up styles/global.css (kata e4sh). The reset global.css brings widened .cfgDir 370 -> 383px, and the old repo-root cwd string then fit inside it with 3.6px to spare - the mutation had stopped failing. The fixture now carries a longer cwd and the mutation overflows by 324.0px. That path deliberately points at this case's own checked-in directory: an earlier draft used the worktree the fix was written in, which would have left the fixture's load-bearing characters made of a branch name that stops existing. Measured slope is 6-8px per character against a threshold near 42, so the fixture has ~33 characters of headroom rather than sitting on the edge.
